## backdown desktop install {#install}

Add BackDown to your applications: the menu and icons (Linux), ~/Applications/BackDown.app (macOS), or the Start menu (Windows). It opens `backdown app`.

```text
backdown desktop install [OPTIONS]
```

### Options

`--autostart`
: Also start BackDown's background service when you log in (Linux and Windows; on macOS, `backdown service install`).

## backdown desktop uninstall {#uninstall}

Remove what `desktop install` added (your index, settings and licence stay)

```text
backdown desktop uninstall [OPTIONS]
```

All of them also take the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.

## Good to know

Linux: `io.backdown.BackDown.desktop` and its icons in `~/.local/share` (with `--autostart`, an autostart entry that runs `backdown app --no-window`). macOS: `~/Applications/BackDown.app`, a small bundle that runs this program (with `--autostart`, the LaunchAgent `backdown service install` makes). Windows: a Start menu entry (with `--autostart`, the scheduled task `backdown service install` makes). `uninstall` removes what `install` added and leaves the background service; `backdown service uninstall` removes that.

## Examples

```sh
backdown desktop install
# Linux and Windows: also start the background service when you log in
backdown desktop install --autostart
backdown desktop uninstall
```
